answer: The circuit was submitted unchanged to garnet:mock with 100 shots. The job was accepted, but it then failed with no counts. The error came from iqm-station-control, stage "circuit_stage", pass "validate_circuits", with error_code unknown. The message was: Circuit 0: No calibration data for 'cz.crf_crf' at ('QB1', 'QB20'). The cause is that QB1 and QB20 are not a coupled pair on Garnet, so the cz gate has no calibration data there. I did not run the arch command to check the coupler list, so this reading comes from the error message only. I did not fix the circuit, as instructed. No credits were used because the job was on a mock.
